description: This source file contains unit tests for ViewModel classes (`NotesListViewModel` and `NoteEditorViewModel`) used in the Note Organizer Android app. It verifies behaviors such as filtering notes, creating, editing, and deleting notes, using in-memory database and mock API services.

classes.name: ViewModelsTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing ViewModel behaviors including filtering, note creation, editing, and deletion within the Note Organizer Android app.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes in-memory database, mock API, and repository before each test.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Closes the database after each test.

methods.name: notesListViewModel_setQuery_filters_results_reactively
methods.description: Tests if setting a query in NotesListViewModel filters notes reactively.

methods.name: noteEditorViewModel_create_trims_input_and_persists_note
methods.description: Verifies creating a new note trims inputs and persists correctly.

methods.name: noteEditorViewModel_edit_updates_existing_note_and_uiState_emits_note
methods.description: Checks editing an existing note updates UI state accordingly.

methods.name: noteEditorViewModel_delete_removes_note_and_calls_onDone
methods.description: Tests deletion of a note and calls the onDone callback.

methods.name: noteEditorViewModel_delete_when_creating_is_noop_and_onDone_called
methods.description: Ensures deleting when creating does nothing but calls onDone.

methods.name: noteEditorViewModel_with_missing_noteId_emits_null_note
methods.description: Checks behavior when a note with a missing ID is accessed.
